title: Document scanner
subtitle: An old camera, a few parts, a useful new instrument.

requirements.label: Image source
requirements.explanation: A working camera becomes the image sensor.

requirements.label: Browser host
requirements.explanation: Runs the capture and image tools. A separate phone camera needs a supported connection or its own browser session.

requirements.label: Vertical support
requirements.explanation: Holds the image source above the work area. Shape, mounting geometry, and stability require inspection.

requirements.label: Camera grip
requirements.explanation: Positions the camera. Test the grip with the actual device before releasing it.

requirements.label: Flat work surface
requirements.explanation: A declared surface at least 220 × 160 mm; larger documents may require a larger surface.

steps.title: Check the parts
steps.instruction: Inspect the support and grip. Confirm the actual camera can attach without blocking its lens or controls. Stop if the geometry does not fit.
steps.check: The device fits the intended mounting position.

steps.title: Prepare the work area
steps.instruction: Place the flat work surface on a stable table. Put the intended subject on it and confirm its footprint fits.
steps.check: The subject fits without hanging off the work surface.

steps.title: Position the camera
steps.instruction: Position the camera above the subject using the support and grip. Keep the device held until you have confirmed the mounting method is stable.
steps.check: The camera faces the subject and remains in position.

steps.title: Connect the image source
steps.instruction: Connect the webcam to its browser host. In SCRAPMIND Camera Lab, select a browser camera and confirm its inventory association. For a separate phone, use its existing camera app and import images from that declared device; remote phone pairing is not available.
steps.check: Your existing camera software shows a real live preview.

steps.title: Make the first scan
steps.instruction: In SCRAPMIND Camera Lab, capture or import an original image from the allocated device. Use the four-corner perspective correction if needed, retaining the original. Inspect the smallest text and page boundaries before recording the capture check.
steps.check: The saved image contains readable text and the full page.

checks.label: The work area fits in the frame
checks.procedure: Capture a sample with all four corners of the intended subject visible.

checks.label: The mount stays in position
checks.procedure: With the actual device secured, observe the frame for 30 seconds. Record any drift or movement. This is a local observation, not load certification.

checks.label: Small text is readable
checks.procedure: Inspect the exported image at full resolution. Read a sample of the smallest text and record the result.

boundaries: Part matching establishes a candidate configuration, not mechanical compatibility.
Camera quality, mounting fit, lighting, and document size must be checked with the actual parts.
No automatic OCR or remote phone discovery is claimed.
